verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਭਰਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਸਜਿ ਭੇਟਤ ਭਤਾਰ ਚਿਤ ਬਿਮਲ ਅਨੰਦ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise banitaa bachitr abharan si(n)gaar saj bheTat bhataar chit bimal ana(n)dh hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife embellished with many form of ornaments feel happy meeting her husband with all the love in her heart,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਰੁਵਰ ਪਰਿਫੁਲਤ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮੁਦਤ ਮਗਨ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise saruvar parifulat kamal dhal madhukar mudhat magan makara(n)dh hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a bumble bee feels satiated drinking the elixir from the lotus flower.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਹਤ ਚਕੋਰ ਦੇਖ ਧਆਨ ਧਰੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਿਰਨ ਅਚਵਤ ਹਿਤ ਚੰਦ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise chit chaahat chakor dhekh dhaan dharai a(n)mirat kiran achavat hit cha(n)dh hai ||

en.bdb: Just as Ruddy sheldrake looks at the moon with rapt attention and drinks its ambrosial rays with his heart and mind;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗਾਇਬੋ ਸੁਨਾਇਬੋ ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈਂ ਮਾਨੋ ਦਾਨ ਕੁਰਖੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਪ ਮੂਲ ਕੰਦ ਹੈ॥੫੬੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise gaibo sunaibo su sabadh sa(n)gat mai(n) maano dhaan kurakhetr paap mool ka(n)dh hai||560||

en.bdb: Similarly, reciting and singing the supreme hymns/words of the True Guru in a congregation assembled in the presence of the True Guru is capable of destroying sins from the roots-just as it is believed that charity made in Kurukshetra destroys all the sins.  (560)
